strategy_roster.name: Alli Heik
strategy_roster.notes: ROC of EMA(5) versus its SMA(5) is a fallback for the smoothed Heiken-Ashi oscillator and signal; all lengths are fallbacks because none are documented. The docs' counterintuitive below-signal long rule is retained; pip stops, target, reverse mode, and trailing are unavailable.

strategy_roster.name: Yuri Garcia Smart Money
strategy_roster.entry_long: low <= donchian_low_prev(low,20) and low < open and close - low >= 0.5 * atr(high,low,close,14) and volume_ratio(volume,20) > ema(volume_ratio(volume,20),5)
strategy_roster.notes: A prior 20-bar support zone, long lower wick, and rising normalized volume proxy the high-volume order-block and wick-pullback rules. Four-hour aggregation, cumulative delta, and ATR-multiple risk-reward exits are not available in the single-series DSL.

strategy_roster.name: CVD Divergence
strategy_roster.entry_long: ema(close,20) > ema(close,50) and rsi(close,14) > 50 and macd(close,12,26) > macd_signal(close,12,26,9) and volume_ratio(volume,20) >= 1.5
strategy_roster.exit_long: ema(close,20) < ema(close,50) or rsi(close,14) < 50 or macd(close,12,26) < macd_signal(close,12,26,9)
strategy_roster.notes: EMA(20/50) replaces HMA, while the documented RSI(14), MACD(12,26,9), and 1.5x volume confirmation are retained. CVD divergence/continuation and its 14/5 swing lengths cannot be represented; no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: Bollinger RSI
strategy_roster.notes: Bollinger(20,2) oversold plus RSI(14)<30 implements the counter-trend long entry, with band re-entry or RSI recovery exiting. Bollinger/RSI lengths are explicit fallbacks because the docs omit them; 2% is the documented stop.

strategy_roster.name: Adaptive KDJ (MTF)
strategy_roster.notes: RSI(9), its EMA(5), and SMA(40) proxy the three-timeframe K/D/J blend and adaptive trend level using documented lengths. Actual KDJ and multi-timeframe aggregation are unavailable; the opposite K/D cross exits and no stops are documented.

strategy_roster.name: SR Breakout
strategy_roster.notes: The source is explicitly an H1/H4 Donchian alert logger and places no orders, so the impossible guard preserves zero trading. Its 26-bar channels can be expressed on one timeframe, but the two subscriptions and logging behavior are outside the roster DSL.

strategy_roster.name: ICT NY Kill Zone Auto Trading
strategy_roster.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high,5) and low < open and close - low >= 0.5 * atr(high,low,close,14)
strategy_roster.notes: A five-bar high break with a rejection wick approximates a fair-value-gap/order-block long setup. Kill-zone time and exact multi-candle gap/order-block geometry are unavailable; documented 30/60 point protection is not a percentage.

strategy_roster.name: Exp Cronex MFI
strategy_roster.notes: Two EMAs of RSI(25) retain the documented 14/25 smoothing lengths and the source's contrarian crossover direction. MFI volume flow, SignalShift, and the 4-hour timeframe are unsupported; no stops are specified.

strategy_roster.name: Trailing Stop Trigger Manager
strategy_roster.notes: This utility only trails externally opened positions and explicitly opens no trades, so no signal is fabricated. Magic-number filtering, bid/ask updates, trigger state, and 1000/1500-point trailing distances require order and quote fields unavailable in the DSL.

strategy_roster.name: Turn of the Month Strategy on Steroids
strategy_roster.notes: ROC(2)<0 with a down close preserves the two-day decline; RSI(2)>65 is the exact exit. Day 25 seasonality cannot be expressed without a date field, and the docs specify no stops.
